note: Set A is better because it binds most claims to specific elevation views (e.g., North Living, West Living) and captures detailed component data (finishes, models like MWD01/02) accurately. Set B frequently uses vague entities like 'Wall section' or 'interior elevation' and contains clear value errors on specific heights (e.g., claiming South Bedroom height is 9'-10" when it is 9'-2"). Although Set A confuses South and West Bedroom labels in several claims, its overall specificity and accuracy on other views are superior.
